result.explanation: Track every accepted identity and sequence permanently. New events are rejected as stale or conflicting before insertion; accepted events are inserted, then contiguous pending sequences are applied exactly once.
result.mapping: state.n is the next unapplied sequence, state.v is the accumulated value, state.i maps IDs to [seq,delta], and state.q maps reserved sequence numbers to [delta].
result.assumptions: Events satisfy the stated legal input constraints. State is returned only to the same instance and is not externally modified.
result.holds: function holds(input,output){if(!Array.isArray(output)||output.length!==input.events.length)return false;var n=1,v=0,ids={},qs={};for(var k=0;k<input.events.length;k++){var e=input.events[k],s=e.seq,id=e.id,d=e.delta,status;if(ids[id])status=ids[id][1]===d?'duplicate':'conflict';else if(qs[s]!==undefined)status='conflict';else if(s<n)status='stale';else{ids[id]=[s,d];qs[s]=d;status='accepted';while(qs[n]!==undefined){v+=qs[n];n++}}var p=[];for(var x in qs)if(+x>=n)p.push(+x);p.sort(function(a,b){return a-b});var o=output[k];if(!o||o.status!==status||o.value!==v||o.next!==n||JSON.stringify(o.pending)!==JSON.stringify(p))return false}return true}
